response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(CAST(g - l AS REAL) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_g_minus_l_per_loss FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_wins FROM t) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_g_minus_l_per_loss, t.avg_wins - m.mean_wins AS gap_above_mean FROM t, m WHERE t.avg_wins > m.mean_wins ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id, pooled across all years and halves in manager_half.
The mean across teams is the unweighted average of the per-team average wins, not the average over all rows.
Rows with losses = 0 give a NULL ratio (division by zero is avoided with NULLIF), and AVG ignores them. The ratio is computed in floating point.
